lanes.summary: The diff correctly declares and implements the `make gate` quality gate command via `scripts/gate.sh`, successfully resolving PMAT-1365. The `scripts/gate.sh` script dynamically identifies workflow steps and ensures the gate faithfully mirrors CI checks, alongside a control script `scripts/gate-control.sh` for falsification and unit tests in `src/make_gate_tests.rs`. The stale binary finding was fixed by dynamically resolving `$PMAT_BIN` in `scripts/gate.sh`. The unrelated roadmap item `PMAT-1386`, which caused a previous scope FAIL, was correctly reverted and is absent from the diff, restoring strict compliance to the ticket's scope. All changes accurately fulfill the ticket's requirements without weakening existing gates or violating refutation constraints.

No foreign roadmap rows are added (PMAT-1386 was landed upstream on master). Both reachability and unrun-tests ledgers are current. No refuting evidence was found.
